title: HDL Cosimulation
source_docs: HDL Verifier/For Use with AMD Vivado Simulator/HDL_Cosimulation.md
text: 通过将 Simulink 与 HDL 仿真器连接来联合仿真 HDL 设计，输入 1 路、输出 1 路；按 {I/O Mode} 指定端口方向 Input；{Block Info}、{Enable direct feedthrough}、{Full HDL Name}、{HDL Type}、{HDL Dims}、{Sample Time}、{Data Type}、{Sign}、{Fraction Length}、{Simulink Word Length}、{HDL Word Length}、{Time to run HDL simulator before cosimulation starts}、{Full HDL Name}、{Active Clock Edge}、{Waveform Type}、{Period/Duration}、{Automatically determine timescale at start of simulation}、1 second in Simulink corresponds to in the HDL simulator、{Connection mode}、{HDL simulator is running on this computer}、{Connection method}、{Host name}、{Port number or service}、{Show connection info on icon}、{Time to run HDL simulator before cosimulation starts}、{Pre-simulation Tcl commands}、{Post-simulation Tcl commands} 同样影响行为；{1 second in Simulink corresponds to in the HDL simulator} 指定 Simulink 与 HDL 仿真器之间的时序关系 integer and time，按实例取值。
